name: The Tenth Doctor
oracle_text:
Allons-y! — Whenever you attack, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. Put three time counters on it. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.
Timey-Wimey — {7}: Time travel three times. Activate only as a sorcery. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter. Then do it two more times.)
blocked_sentences: Timey-Wimey — {7}: Time travel three times. Activate only as a sorcery. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter. Then do it two more times.)

needs.what: an op, with an amount for 'time travel three times', that for each suspended card the controller owns (in exile, suspended, with time counters) and each permanent they control with a time counter on it lets them choose to add one time counter, remove one, or do nothing, repeated N times; removing the last time counter from a suspended card must cast it without paying its mana cost as suspend does (702.62)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No time_travel op is in reference. repeat + for_each + choose_mode over add_counters/remove_counters is the near miss, but no selector key reads 'suspended' (has_counters in exile also matches non-suspended exiled cards), and the free cast on removing the last counter lives only in suspend's upkeep tick, so an effect removing it would strand the card in exile. The Allons-y! line looks expressible (you_attack trigger, exile_until a nonland card bound with as, then the suspend op with amount 3 on that binding), and the activated ability's cost is mana {7} with sorcery_speed_only.
